==Acquisition ==
This skill is available while under the [[G.O.L.E.M. (disguise)|G.O.L.E.M. disguise]] during the [[April Fools' Day]] quest [[Annihilator 2: Searing Day]].

==Notes==
* This skill is [[disable]]d anywhere except a predefined area around a lava pit in [[Ashford Catacombs: 1070 AE]].

==Trivia==
* It actually [[teleport]]s the target into the lava pit.
